speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have learned your part. You may now recover at your leisure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are early, or I am late. I cannot tell which from the bolster.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in the bed, and he is as far as the chair. Mark me. The chair is the limit.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I need one thing. Which of the two corrections is current?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The second. At the third speech, say Ephesus, not Epidamnum. The wrong city throws the next entrance.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: A reason will not help an entrance.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The two names sit too near. A tired mouth takes the first. That is the reason.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will take the second correction, since you say it is current. I will not take the reason with it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Bread, and broth. They go between you. Compare the roll. Do not gesture over the bowl.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have the tale. It is long. I have it anyway.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the worst part in England for a man with no voice. You have a voice. Use it where I used the consonants.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I shall use the whole word. You may keep the consonants. They will not help an entrance either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two of the clock. The play begins at two. You will be there, Master Cowley. This one will not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. That is the cold. It is not a kindness I am doing the company.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I did not come for a kindness. I came for the current line. Ephesus, at the third speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For today. Do not mend the book. Mend the roll you carry.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I do not carry the book. I carry this roll. This roll will say Ephesus once I write it in.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Write it, then. And do not make a tale of a man who stayed in bed. He is fevered. That is the whole tale.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There are two marks. The first is already on your roll. Leave it. The second is the one that matters.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then the second is current, and the first is not the question. I have that without a reason.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: As I am a Christian woman, if either of you says reason again I shall take the roll downstairs.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Ephesus. I will say it once more at the door, and then I am gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it at the door. They begin at two. Tell no one I sent a speech with you. I sent a word.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He sent a word. The broth is his. You have had yours, I think.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I have eaten. The stair is yours again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The vowels went first with me. You will not have that trouble.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: A reason will not help an entrance. I have said so. I am at the Keys at two, with Ephesus.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you will stay where you are. I am not carrying this bowl up twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am where I am. Go on, I hear you.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: You do not need to hear me. You need Ephesus at the third speech, and you have given it. Good day.
